nom: COSRX Clear Fit Master Patch - Day Care

segments.sensitive: One reviewer with sensitive, acne-prone skin in her 30s reports the patches did not burn or irritate and helped reduce blemishes without picking-related scarring.
segments.normal: A reviewer who says she rarely gets pimples or blemishes keeps these on hand for occasional breakouts and finds them easy to apply.

concerns.spots: Most reviewers describe visible whiteheads or surface pimples flattening, draining, or disappearing within one to three nights; several note the patch only works once the blemish has a head or something to drain.
concerns.blemishes: Many report reduced size, redness and soreness of blemishes overnight, with visible pus/gunk on the used patch as proof of drainage; a few say the patches did nothing or even made a pimple feel more sore and ripe.
concerns.oiliness: One reviewer attributes her recurring small breakouts to pores easily picking up dirt and oil, and reports the patches keep new spots from worsening rather than clearing oiliness itself.

aspects.libelle: Ineffective on deep or cystic acne
Thin and nearly invisible on skin

extraits.titre: had high hopes.. they were crushed.
extraits.texte: honestly they didn't do absolutely anything. no sugar coating here.

The patches did not do much for my pimples. My pimples was ready to pop so I put on the patches and all it did was make it even more ripe rather than removing it. I tried the patches 3 times on the same pimple.

I've always struggled with constantly having two or three blemishes, even in my 30s, which I think is due to my pores too easily sucking in germs and dirt than anything else (yeah, gross). I don't have acne like you see on commercials, I won't pretend to know that struggle, but it still gets me down, especially since I end up impulsively picking and scarring, leading to needing makeup to feel confident. Nothing has worked (I've tried SO many things and have been vigilant) like these do. When I start to notice a spot, I pop one of these on so I can't touch it, and somehow the spot fades (I want to say it's like magic but that's real cliche). Not entirely and not so much I don't have to wear makeup, but it doesn't get worse and it definitely is smaller the next day. I also have pretty sensitive skin, so anything can burn me, but these don't. I wear them in private, as you can tell you're wearing them (even though they're "day" patches), but even if you use one from 10pm to the next morning it helps. This isn't medical advice, but I wear one every night (or as soon as possible when I notice a blemish forming) until the spot doesn't react to touch (meaning the swelling/infection has gone down so that it isn't that sore feeling like when it first crops up) and then it's pretty clear I'm out of the woods; if I catch it early enough I only have to use one.

i use the original and th clear fit. they both work, but the clear fit is pretty much invisible compared to the original. both work great to flatten a zit and help healing times and scarring, but there needs to actually be something to drain, so it won't work for say, cystic acne.

These little invisible patches are a game changer. I bought these to try, though I was very skeptical of their efficacy but I was pleasantly surprised. I get hormonal acne on my jawline, that tend to be deep cysts and only come to the surface after I have spent hours (sometimes days) trying to coax it to pop. I put one of these patches on during the day and no more than 2 hours later, I had not one but TWO white heads brought to the surface. I followed that patch with the other cosrx patch (red one) and my horrible zit was gone the next day. These have changed everything!

These seem to be an upgraded version of the other CosRX patches. I love them! They work extremely well; the longer you can keep it on at one time the better. They are also clear enough to wear out and about. Keep in mind that these are meant for whiteheads moreso than any "under the skin" type blemishes.
I hardly get pimples or blemishes but these are so nice to have on hand in case one does decide to show up on my face. I like that there are different sizes of patches as well
